title: Finite scalar tensor reduction respects the native symmetry
statement: In the finite coefficient setting P of [def-pur-conventions] with 1 ≤ m ≤ P.level and scheme T, the representative-normalized tensorator of [def-pur-finite-signed-reduction-comparisons] for scalar reduction [def-pur-finite-tensor-reduction-data] commutes with the native derived symmetry of [def-weil-derived-tensor] on every pair of derived objects. Explicitly F(β(U,V)) followed by c(V,U) equals c(U,V) followed by β(FU,FV).

proof.text: Use the completed native braided structure on derived scalar extension. The scalar monoidal model is its transport along the canonical comparison of left adjoints. Mathlib makes that comparison monoidal and transports lax braidedness. Cancel the invertible tensorator to express braidedness as the required inverse-tensorator square.

The candidate representative equation makes the actual constructed model normalized. The existing uniqueness theorem for the normalized scalar core identifies it with finiteTensorCore. Substitute this equality into the transported braidedness square.

proof_origin.place: Step 2: native derived scalar braiding, transported along left-adjoint uniqueness; normalized-core uniqueness identifies the chosen core.
proof_origin.note: The public theorem statement and docstring are unchanged. This shorter completed-library route replaces the old concrete cochain conversion after the normalization interface repair, which otherwise exceeded the file limit. No adopted source declaration or import changes.
